threads.body: [Testing] Excluding `ChatModelTest` removes all streaming coverage from the 2.x suite: both replacement tests exercise only `call()`. Consequently, the separate `StreamAdvice`/`SpringAiStreamTracing` path is never exercised against 2.x, despite the README advertising streaming support. Please extract the compatible streaming tests into shared sources or add a 2.x streaming integration test that subscribes to completion and asserts the resulting trace and telemetry.

[Testing] `version2Test` only runs with message-content capture disabled. The existing `testCaptureMessageContent` task uses the 1.x test outputs and runtime classpath, so the capture-enabled assertions inherited by `OpenAiChatModelV2Test` never check Spring AI 2.x message objects. Add a capture-enabled execution of that test using the `version2Test` outputs and runtime classpath, and wire it into `check` while retaining the default-off execution.
